comparison.objective: Join two pipes by sliding a repair coupling across their joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift and align a loose pipe end while translating a sleeve coupling over both pipes.
comparison.success_condition: Each pipe at least 30 mm inside centered coupling, pipe aligned and home, grippers 50 mm clear, still 1 s; separation or dropped parts fails.
comparison.reason: Coaxial alignment and sleeve insertion are unrelated to granular screening. No material rubric detail is missing.
